claims.claim: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B with OpenHands CodeActAgent 2.1: SWE-bench Verified resolution increased from 1.8% to 10.6% after training on 491 successful teacher trajectories. Historical author-reported outcomes.
The 32B self-generated trajectory mixture reduced SWE-bench Lite resolution from 15.3% to 8.7%; improvement is not guaranteed.
MoatlessTools 7B iterations: 7.0%, 9.0%, 10.0%; 32B: 19.0%, 19.7%, 19.7%. These are a separate constrained scaffold and endpoint.
Build environments before tasks; validate introduced faults against passing tests. Generation strategy and problem description affect training signal.
Aggregate expert labels on learner-visited states; guarantees depend on specific imitation-learning assumptions.
Agent-only data harms held-out/general performance in the reported ablation; small-model mixed-training held-out gains were close to the general-only baseline.
